title: Isomorphisms of free group factors
author: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic)
description: OpenAI's theorem (2026) that the free group factors L(F_n), 2 <= n < infinity, are all isomorphic. Part one proves OpenAI's rank step L(F_n) = L(F_{n+1}) for n >= 3: free independence in tracial von Neumann algebras, freely generating Haar tuples, a bounded logarithm of the extra generator and a norm bound for free sums that does not depend on the number of summands; trace-preserving polynomial flows (a cocycle on the free group, a formal derivation whose trace vanishes at time zero, global unitary solutions, moment invariance through analyticity, normal automorphisms with displacement bounds); a small cocycle with a prescribed word value (free prefixes, Catalan moments, a limit law without an atom at zero, cutoff inversion); and the generating limit with adaptive error budgets. Part two proves Voiculescu's corner formula p L(F_n) p = L(F_{4n-3}) for a projection of trace one half and deduces L(F_2) = L(F_3): distributions of normal elements and Haar generators, the semicircle law, a freeness criterion on the full Fock space, free semicircular families and their vacuum trace, 2x2 matrices with semicircular and circular entries that are free from matrices over the other variables, the polar decomposition of a circular element (a Haar unitary free from a quarter-circular modulus), and the corner computation. Part three extends the corner formula to every projection of trace 1/k, p L(F_n) p = L(F_{1+k^2(n-1)}), with k x k semicircular matrices and conjugation by several free Haar unitaries, and deduces that every corner of L(F_2) of rational trace and every M_m(C) (x) L(F_2) is isomorphic to L(F_2): every positive rational number lies in the fundamental group of L(F_2).
prerequisites: generators-of-ii1-factors lesson haar-unitaries-freeness-and-ultraproducts (Definition 2.1 Haar unitaries, Lemma 2.3 equivalence of projections of equal trace, Corollary 2.4 Haar unitaries of corners and projections of every trace)
